desktopOnly.title: Desktop Only
desktopOnly.description: LLM Wiki workspace setup is currently available only inside the local desktop app.

hero.title: Turn your Obsidian vault into a maintained LLM Wiki.
hero.description: Deeting reads your vault locally, creates a bounded managed workspace, and keeps it synchronized through retrieval, delegated maintenance, and long-term knowledge growth.
hero.writeScope: Writes only to the managed workspace

metrics.notesHint: Vault notes available for local retrieval
metrics.attachmentsHint: Files that can feed summaries and source pages

journey.title: Move from local vault binding to explicit wiki delegation.
journey.description: Keep the system bounded: connect the vault, bootstrap the managed workspace and dedicated corpus, then verify the maintainer-only retrieval path before handing off wiki work.
journey.boundary: The main assistant still stays off this corpus by default. The maintainer path only becomes active after an explicit handoff.

connect.title: Connect Vault
connect.description: Bind the existing Obsidian vault and confirm the local read boundary before Deeting touches anything else.
connect.ready: {vaultName} is connected and {count} markdown notes are visible for local scan.
connect.pending: Analyze the vault root first so Deeting can confirm the scan scope and managed workspace target.

bootstrap.title: Bootstrap + Sync
bootstrap.description: Create the bounded wiki scaffold, then reconcile the dedicated corpus that only the maintainer agent will use.
bootstrap.ready: Workspace is ready at {path} and the dedicated corpus has {count} indexed notes.
bootstrap.pending: Create the managed workspace and run at least one corpus reconcile before the maintainer can search local wiki evidence.

handoff.title: Inspect + Handoff
handoff.description: Open the Corpus & Inspector tab, review the material hits, then reconcile the maintenance agent setup so delegated wiki work stays visible and bounded.
handoff.ready: Inspector has been exercised with {count} visible result(s), and {name} is ready for delegated maintenance.
handoff.pending: Open the Corpus & Inspector tab, run one material search, and reconcile the maintenance agent setup before delegating wiki work.
handoff.pendingWithMaintainer: {name} is ready. Go to the Corpus & Inspector tab and run one more material search to verify the context it will see.

binding.title: Connect the vault you already use.
binding.description: Paste the absolute vault path, then let Deeting scan it locally and reserve a managed workspace inside it.

safety.title: Read broad, write narrow
safety.description: Deeting can read the whole vault for context, but the default write scope stays inside the managed workspace only.

vaultRoot.label: Obsidian Vault Root
vaultRoot.description: Use the absolute path to your existing Obsidian vault.

workspacePath.label: Managed Workspace Path
workspacePath.description: Relative to the vault root. Deeting writes the LLM Wiki here.

adoptFolder.label: Existing Folder To Adopt
adoptFolder.description: Pick the folder Deeting should preview as an existing wiki area before it begins maintenance.

managed.title: Managed Workspace
managed.description: Create or maintain a bounded Deeting Wiki workspace inside the vault.

adopt.title: Adopt Existing Folder
adopt.description: Preview an existing folder first, then confirm adoption only after classification looks correct.

maintenance.title: Operate the wiki like a maintained workspace.
maintenance.description: Rescan the vault, ingest source material, rebuild the dedicated index, run lint, and review recent lifecycle actions without leaving the LLM Wiki surface.

ingest.title: Ingest Selection
ingest.description: Register existing vault paths into the managed wiki. Markdown becomes source pages; files are copied into raw sources.
ingest.hint: Enter one or more vault-relative paths, separated by new lines or commas.

lint.title: Lint And Claim Review
lint.description: Detect stale summaries, weak links, duplicate titles, orphan pages, and candidate supersession with explicit confidence levels.
lint.summary: {count} finding(s) in the latest lint run at {generatedAt}.
lint.empty: No findings were produced in the latest lint run.
lint.notRun: Lint has not been run yet.

lifecycle.title: Recent Lifecycle Actions
lifecycle.description: Latest visible maintenance, automation, and crystallization actions.
lifecycle.empty: No lifecycle actions have been recorded yet.

workspace.title: Bootstrap the managed wiki, not just an index.
workspace.description: Deeting creates the minimum files needed for a usable LLM Wiki and personalizes them from the vault scan.
workspace.pathPlaceholder: Analyze a vault first to resolve the workspace path.
workspace.adoptModeNote: This folder is being adopted rather than scaffolded. Confirm adoption in the binding section, then use maintenance actions instead of bootstrap.

lifecycle.title: Reuse Deeting's local retrieval and maintenance stack.
lifecycle.description: The page is only the product surface. Underneath, Deeting can already reuse hybrid retrieval, lifecycle scoring, and delegated maintenance patterns.

scan.title: Index the vault, not the user's memory
scan.description: Vault files first become retrieval inputs through local scanning, embeddings, and lexical indexing.

retrieve.title: Let runtime decide what matters now
retrieve.description: Normal chat stays retrieval-first. Runtime only decides when something deserves a maintenance action.

delegate.title: Delegate markdown maintenance
delegate.description: Task agents own the bounded write path so wiki updates remain reviewable and intentional.

promote.title: Promote only stable conclusions
promote.description: User memory stays narrower than the wiki and only receives durable, high-value knowledge.

corpus.title: Refresh and inspect the dedicated source set.
corpus.description: This source set stays separate from the main knowledge surface. It exists for the wiki maintenance agent, while reusing the same retrieval and lifecycle stack underneath.

preview.title: Material matches
preview.hint: Enter a keyword, then click Search or press Enter.
preview.empty: Run one search to inspect what the maintenance agent can see.
preview.noResults: No matches for the current keyword.

inspector.title: Material inspector
inspector.empty: Select a result to inspect what the maintenance agent would receive.

agentUses.title: Visible to the maintenance agent
agentUses.description: This view reflects the same dedicated material set that the wiki maintenance agent can search during delegated work.

corpus.note: The main assistant does not read from this dedicated material set by default. It is reserved for explicit delegation to the wiki maintenance agent.

agent.title: Wire a task agent to maintain the workspace.
agent.description: Use the generated prompt as the maintenance contract for a custom task agent, then let Deeting delegate wiki work into a bounded write scope.

currentAgent.label: Current Maintainer
currentAgent.emptyDescription: Create one now so Deeting can delegate wiki maintenance into a bounded write scope.

tip.title: Keep the main runtime clean
tip.description: The maintainer agent should update pages, source summaries, and logs. The main chat runtime should stay retrieval-focused and trigger delegation only when needed.

prerequisite.title: Configure Obsidian MCP first
prerequisite.description: To let the maintenance agent actually read and write pages back into Obsidian, first configure Obsidian MCP for this vault using the official guide. This page creates the maintenance-agent profile, but it does not install or connect Obsidian MCP for you.

stepOne.title: Open the maintainer workspace
stepOne.description: Make sure Obsidian MCP is connected to this vault first, then jump into the task-agent dashboard to continue setup.

stepTwo.title: Review the maintenance contract
stepTwo.description: The prompt already carries the read/write boundary and the Deeting Wiki ownership model.

stepThree.title: Save and delegate through normal work
stepThree.description: Once saved, the agent can handle crystallization, source review, and ongoing wiki maintenance.

automation.title: Keep maintenance suggestions visible and easy to act on.
automation.description: The system can remind you to refresh materials, review updates, or hand work to the maintenance agent without quietly changing the wiki in the background.

autoSyncOnVaultBound.title: Prepare materials after connect
autoSyncOnVaultBound.description: When a vault is connected, run the first sync automatically so maintenance can start immediately.

suggestMaintainerOnWorkspaceBootstrap.title: Prompt for a maintenance agent after setup
suggestMaintainerOnWorkspaceBootstrap.description: Once the workspace is ready, suggest creating or updating the dedicated wiki maintenance agent.

autoRefreshInspectorOnCorpusSync.title: Prompt me to review after sync
autoRefreshInspectorOnCorpusSync.description: After new materials are synced, surface a visible reminder to inspect a few fresh hits.

createCrystallizationCandidatesOnSession.title: Create a review suggestion after each session
createCrystallizationCandidatesOnSession.description: When a conversation ends, surface a visible suggestion so you can decide whether it belongs in the wiki.

enableScheduleSuggestions.title: Show routine maintenance reminders
enableScheduleSuggestions.description: On a schedule, suggest refreshing materials, checking stale pages, and running lint.

suggestOnValuableAnswer.title: Suggest capturing valuable answers
suggestOnValuableAnswer.description: When an answer looks worth keeping long term, surface a wiki suggestion for review.

autoDelegateNewSources.title: Auto-delegate new materials
autoDelegateNewSources.description: When fresh material arrives in the dedicated wiki source set, automatically start a maintenance pass.

autoDelegateMaintenanceSchedule.title: Auto-delegate routine checks
autoDelegateMaintenanceSchedule.description: When the routine check window arrives, automatically start a maintenance task.

promoteRepeatedStableConclusionsToMemory.title: Write repeated stable conclusions to long-term memory
promoteRepeatedStableConclusionsToMemory.description: If the same stable conclusion appears again and again, allow the system to save it into local long-term memory.

suggestions.title: Suggested actions
suggestions.empty: There are no automation suggestions waiting for you right now.
suggestions.emptySubtitle: The system will generate suggestions when needed

initialCorpusSync.title: Run the first materials sync
initialCorpusSync.description: You just connected the vault. Prepare the dedicated source set first so later maintenance and search are more complete.

createMaintainerAgent.title: Set up the wiki maintenance agent
createMaintainerAgent.description: The workspace is ready. Create the dedicated agent that keeps the wiki organized before you hand maintenance over to it.

refreshCorpus.title: Refresh the dedicated source set
refreshCorpus.description: These materials look a little stale. Refresh them before the next wiki maintenance pass.

maintenanceReview.title: Schedule a routine maintenance pass
maintenanceReview.description: Ask the maintenance agent to run a bounded review for stale pages, missing source summaries, and content that may need merging.

sessionCrystallization.title: Review the session that just ended
sessionCrystallization.description: A conversation just finished. Check its summary and decide whether it should become a wiki page or analysis note.

valuableAnswer.title: Capture a valuable answer
valuableAnswer.description: A recent answer looks worth keeping. Review it and decide whether it should be turned into a maintained wiki entry.

inspectAfterSync.title: Inspect the newly refreshed materials
inspectAfterSync.description: The source set just changed. Review a few hits in the inspector before you continue with maintenance.

reviewNewSources.title: Review new source material
reviewNewSources.description: Fresh material entered the dedicated source set. Let the maintenance agent inspect it before deciding whether the wiki needs updates.

memoryPromotion.title: Review the long-term memory update
memoryPromotion.description: The system detected a repeated stable conclusion and saved it into local long-term memory. Review the outcome if needed.

audit.title: Recent activity
audit.empty: No automation activity has been recorded yet.

auditCopy.vaultBoundAutoExecuted: After the vault was connected, the system refreshed the dedicated materials automatically. Added {indexedFiles} item(s) and cleared {removedFiles} stale item(s).
auditCopy.vaultBoundAutoFailed: Automatic material preparation after vault connect failed.
auditCopy.workspaceBootstrapNoop: The workspace is already ready and a maintenance agent already exists, so nothing else was needed.
auditCopy.sessionEndDisabled: Session-end organization is turned off, so no suggestion was created this time.
auditCopy.sessionEndSkipped: This session did not have a usable summary, so no organization suggestion was created.
auditCopy.sessionEndObserved: A summary for this finished session was refreshed, and the related organization suggestion was reinforced.
auditCopy.sessionEndSuggested: The system created an organization suggestion for a session that just ended.
auditCopy.valuableAnswerDisabled: Valuable-answer suggestions are turned off, so no suggestion was created this time.
auditCopy.valuableAnswerSuggested: The system created an organization suggestion for a valuable answer.
auditCopy.corpusReconcileObserved: Material reconcile completed. Added {indexedFiles} item(s) and cleared {removedFiles} stale item(s).
auditCopy.newSourceAutoExecuted: After new material was detected, the system automatically started a maintenance task.
auditCopy.newSourceAutoFailed: Automatic maintenance after detecting new material failed.
auditCopy.maintenanceAutoExecuted: The system automatically started a routine maintenance task.
auditCopy.maintenanceScheduled: The system just completed a routine maintenance evaluation.
auditCopy.stableConclusionAutoExecuted: The system saved a repeated stable conclusion into local long-term memory.
auditCopy.suggestionExecutedSync: The suggested material refresh was completed. Added {indexedFiles} item(s) and cleared {removedFiles} stale item(s).
auditCopy.suggestionExecutedCreateAgent: The suggested maintenance agent was set up: {name}.
auditCopy.suggestionExecutedWorkflow: The suggested maintenance task was started.
auditCopy.suggestionExecutedMemory: The suggested stable conclusion was saved into long-term memory.

boundary.title: The default boundary still holds
boundary.description: These automations can refresh materials, create reminders, or start maintenance work, but they do not widen the main chat assistant's default retrieval scope.
